what: Goodman equivalent fully reversed stress amplitudes, including zero mean, a mean near ultimate and a non-finite domain boundary.

axes.x: anterior, the rod's longitudinal stress direction

signConvention: Scalar longitudinal stress is tensile-positive. amplitudeMpa is the nonnegative half range, meanMpa the signed cycle mean and ultimateMpa a positive tensile ultimate stress. equivalentAmplitudeMpa is the nonnegative fully reversed amplitude. For meanMpa >= ultimateMpa this fixture expects status no-finite-answer and a null amplitude, never a finite, negative, clamped or zero result. Status and null are compared exactly, not by tolerance.

tolerance.rule: abs(actual - expected) <= absolute + relative * abs(expected), for finite numeric outputs in their stated units
tolerance.why: Closed-form arithmetic with at least 16 significant digits. The 0.001 near-ultimate denominator is far enough from zero for this tight bound; no tolerance crosses the exact domain boundary.

cases.what: zero mean leaves the amplitude unchanged
mean at one quarter of ultimate
different amplitude and ultimate, mean at three quarters of ultimate
mean reaches ultimate; positive amplitude has no finite answer
mean exceeds ultimate; the Goodman conversion is outside its finite-amplitude domain
